title: Instrumentation is observation, not authority
summary: SMTP semantic audit events remain service-owned evidence. Instrumentation Mesh receives a deliberately lossy operational projection and cannot become a source of mail, RPC, signing, sending or retry authority.
invariants: Instrumentation excludes message content, RPC arguments, mail addresses, remote addresses, principals, certificate identities and raw private RPC correlation ids from ordinary dimensions.
The default RPC instrumentation mapper publishes no correlation id.
Cross-service correlation is opt-in through a deployment-owned mapper that translates a private RPC correlation id to a separate opaque observability token.
Instrumentation correlation groups are read-only evidence organization and never grant RPC_INVOKE, MAILSIGN, EMAIL_SEND, delivery or retry authority.
Audit/event evidence and operational metrics may coexist through composite sinks without conflating their authority.

provenance.claim: Implements bounded SMTP/RPC projections and explicit private-to-observability correlation mapping.
Executable qualification of default no-correlation privacy and explicit opaque correlation grouping.
